title: The High Cost of Data Augmentation for Learning Equivariant Models
summary: According to Noether's theorem the presence of a continuous symmetry in a Hamiltonian systems is equivalent to the existence of a conserved quantity, yet these symmetries are not always explicitly enforced in data-driven models. There remains a debate whether or not encoding of symmetry into a model architecture is the optimal approach. A competing approach is to target approximate symmetry through data augmentation.
